steps_raw.instruction: Dog ID _________________________ Date _________________________ Completed by _________________________ Cancer Pain Study CANINE HEALTH-RELATED QUALITY OF LIFE INDEX (CHQoLI) Copyrights / Propriété intellectuelle – 2015

CANINE HEALTH-RELATED QUALITY OF LIFE INDEX (CHQOLI) –  GREPAQ This questionnaire is divided into three domains. For each domain, please select only one answer per item. If you believe that an item does not apply to your dog, simply check “I cannot answer”. This item will be crossed out when completing this questionnaire in future visits. A. Happiness Happiness is a subjective evaluation of quality of life and it relates to how much your dog is active and interacts with you and/or other animals at home. Please respond to the following items according to your dog’s condition in the past 5 days 1. Willingness to play Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 2. Response to my presence (coming back to home, enter in a room) Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 3. Interaction with family members Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 4. Good days versus bad days Normal (as before health problem) 0 Bad days are occasional 1 Bad days occur half of the time 2 Bad days are more frequent 3 I cannot answer --- Total score Happiness ____________

B. Physical functioning Please respond to the following items according to your dog’s condition in the past 5 days 5. Mobility (walking, trotting or running) Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 6. Stiffness after a prolonged rest (e.g., after morning waking-up) None (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 7. Mobility / stiffness after exercising Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 8. Getting in/out the car or jumping on/off the bed Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 9. Climbing up/down the stairs Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Mild alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 10. Lameness during activities None (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- 11. Lameness the day after activities None (as before health problem) 0 Rarely 1 Frequently 2 Constantly 3 I cannot answer --- 12. Getting up after lying down for at least 15 minutes Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 I cannot answer --- Total score Physical functioning __________ ____________

C. Quality of Life Please respond to the following items according to your dog’s condition in the past 5 days 13. I am concerned about my dog’s quality of life Not concerned 0 Mildly concerned 1 Moderately concerned 2 Severely concerned 3 I cannot answer -- 14. I am c oncerned about my dog’s general appearance (smells like urine, has skin irritation, greasy hair, matted or rough looking) Not concerned 0 Mildly concerned 1 Moderately concerned 2 Severely concerned 3 I cannot answer --- 15. My dog sleeps more, is less awake Normal (as before health problem) 0 Rarely 1 Frequently 2 Constantly 3 I cannot answer --- 16. My dog seems dull or depressed, not alert Normal (as before health problem) 0 Rarely 1 Frequently 2 Constantly 3 I cannot answer --- 17. My dog pants frequently, even at rest Normal (as before health problem) 0 Rarely 1 Frequently 2 Constantly 3 I cannot answer --- 18. My dog shakes or trembles Normal (as before health problem) 0 Rarely 1 Frequently 2 Constantly 3 I cannot answer --- 19. My dog’s overall quality of life Normal (as before health problem) 0 Mildly impaired 1 Moderately impaired 2 Severely impaired 3 I cannot answer --- Total score Quality of life __________ ____________

Specific behavioral change If you wish, add any change that you consider specific to your dog and that is highly affected by the painful condition 20. Please score this change Normal (as before health problem) 0 Please note that Normal cannot be selected at first completion Mild alteration 1 Moderate alteration 2 Severe alteration 3 Most representative item for your dog’s condition Please select within each domain, the item that you consider the most affected by the painful condition of your dog. Select only one item per domain. A. Happiness Willingness to play Responds to my presence Enjoys life and gives attention to the family Good days versus bad days C. Quality of fife Concern about the quality of life of your dog Concern about the appearance of your dog My dog sleeps more, is less awake My dog seems dull or depressed, not alert My dog pants frequently, even at rest My dog shakes or trembles B. Specific behavioral change Describe : ______________________________________________ Score for Specific change __________ ____________

To be valid, no more than 8 “I cannot answer” should appear Questions completed at Baseline must be completed at each visit T0: Baseline Total score (Happiness + Physical functioning + Quality of life + Specific behavior change (if completed)) _________ Maximum score (number of valid questions x 3) _________ Total score (%) (Total score/Maximum score x 100) ________% T1: Day 0 Total score (Happiness + Physical functioning + Quality of life + Specific behavior change (if completed)) _________ Maximum score (number of valid questions x 3) As defined at T0 Total score (%) (Total score/Maximum score x 100) ________% T2: Day 14 Total score (Happiness + Physical functioning + Quality of life + Specific behavior change (if completed)) _________ Maximum score (number of valid questions x 3) As defined at T0 Total score (%) (Total score/Maximum score x 100) ________% T3: Day 21 Total score (Happiness + Physical functioning + Quality of life + Specific behavior change (if completed)) _________ Maximum score (number of valid questions x 3) As defined at T0 Total score (%) (Total score/Maximum score x 100) ________% T4: Day 28 Total score (Happiness + Physical functioning + Quality of life + Specific behavior change (if completed)) _________ Maximum score (number of valid questions x 3) As defined at T0 Total score (%) (Total score/Maximum score x 100) ________%
